title: Demand a Recount
author: AaronH
rules:
Rules

• Sudoku: Fill the grid with digits 1-9 so that no digit repeats in any row, column or 3×3 box.

• Dynamic Clues: Placing correct digits into the grid may cause clues to appear or disappear. No guessing is required. Placed digits are to be kept as the puzzle changes, pencilmarks do not have this requirement.

• Counting Circles: A digit inside a circle indicates how many times that digits appears among all circled cells.

• Black Dots: A black dot connects two digits where one is exactly double the other.
